name: Generic API Connector
author: CodeCraft
description: Connects to any REST API via a configured base URL and optional bearer token. Read-only GET calls run freely; anything else (POST/PUT/DELETE) requires approval, since a generic connector can't know which calls are safe.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Read-only GET request against the configured API.

tools.name: call
tools.description: Any HTTP method against the configured API - requires approval.
